R095.title: Byte-view and validator case study
R095.question: Verify representative IntoBytes, byte-writing, boolean-validation, and array laws across candidates, including incorrect variants.
R095.rationale: These examples exercise zerocopy's defining representation obligations and test whether each candidate captures initializedness and validation semantics.
sections: F1. One finite meaning fixes all four obligations
F2. Strict verdicts expose an export compatibility boundary
F3. Incorrect variants preserve their real logical distinction
F4. Observed costs distinguish stages without ranking systems
F5. Proof closure and operational failures remain visible
R095.answered_scope: All four finite laws compared under identical per-law predicates, meaningful wrong variants, actual Lean proofs/reflection and solver/certificate outcomes, countermodel reification and separated3sample costs. Only one complete SMT law and a write projection strict-valid.
future_engineering: Named Rust-backend/physical source interpretation, parser/quotation and native checking closure remain explicit; completing a producer/checker rule adapter is separate from this performed comparison.
